title: Evaluating ChatGPT's Performance for Multilingual and Emoji-based Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing ChatGPT's macro F1 scores, functionality test accuracy, and failure rates in classifying hate speech across 11 different languages using the Multilingual HateCheck (MHC) suite.

Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets specific racial or ethnic groups such as Black People, Asian People, North-East Indians, and Indigenous People.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets specific religious groups such as Jews and Muslims.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Women.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Trans People.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Gay People.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Disabled People.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Immigrants and Refugees.
Evaluating variations in hate speech detection performance (macro F1 scores) when the content targets Lower Caste individuals.
